content.title: Manon Bannerman Will Not Join KATSEYE for 2026 Coachella Performance amid Hiatus from Group: Report
content.text: (from left) Sophia Laforteza, Yoonchae, Manon Bannerman, Megan Skiendiel, Daniela Avanzini and Lara Raj of KATSEYE in February 2026. Credit : Todd Owyoung/NBC via Getty NEED TO KNOW Manon Bannerman announced her hiatus from KATSEYE in February to focus on her health and wellbeingBannerman removed KATSEYE from her Instagram bio and thanked fans for their support on the platform WeverseKATSEYE released a new single and music video ahead of Coachella, but Bannerman does not appear in either Manon Bannerman will reportedly not join KATSEYE at Coachella. The Switzerland-born musician announced her hiatus from the "Gnarly" group in February and removed KATSEYE from her Instagram bio earlier this month. On Thursday, April 9, record label and management company HYBE issued a statement to The Korea Herald confirming Bannerman, 23, won't perform at Coachella with KATSEYE on April 10 and 17. "Manon remains on hiatus," read HYBE's statement to the outlet. Reps for KATSEYE did not immediately respond to PEOPLE's request for comment. Manon Bannerman in New York in September 2025. Kevin Mazur/Getty Bannerman's hiatus was announced in February via the group's official X account. “Hello. After open and thoughtful conversations together, we are sharing that Manon will be taking a temporary hiatus from group activities to focus on her health and wellbeing,” the statement began. “We fully support this decision. KATSEYE remains committed to showing up for one another and for the fans who mean everything to us. The group will continue scheduled activities during this time, and we look forward to being together again when the time is right," continued the post. Related Stories Bannerman later reportedly shared a message about her hiatus to the fan platform Weverse. “Thank you so much for all the love and support you've been sending my way,” she wrote. “I'm really grateful for the patience and kindness everyone has shown during this time. HxG and I are having positive conversations and I feel supported. I'm happy and I'm healthy. I'll share more soon. Thank you for always being there for me.” The performer also appeared to remove any reference to KATSEYE from her Instagram bio, which now just reads, "mademoiselle manzanita." KATSEYE. Rahul Bhatt In a cover story interview with NYLON earlier this week, Bannerman spoke about how KATSEYE's members — Yoonchae Jeung, Sophia Laforteza, Daniela Avanzini, Lara Raj and Megan Skiendiel — were not always on the "same page." “Being in a group, it's just about good communication and setting good boundaries and building a friendship, but also work relationship, and always remembering that it's a shared goal that we have,” Bannerman told the outlet. She explained that "obviously not everyone's always going to be on the same page about everything" and gave an example of two members having to choose which one of them would wear a certain outfit. “But I think we all are at, or have been learning and are finally coming to, a point where for the group's sake, you give and you take," said Bannerman. "You pick your battles.” KATSEYE released a new single, "PINKY UP," as well as a music video on Thursday, April 9 ahead of the group's upcoming Coachella performance.
